reason: I already run my shop and the cash discount works. $49 a month plus a $299 reader is real money, and I have never heard of this company. I would want to hear from another owner first before I change how I take money.
objection: I need someone to come set it up and answer the phone in Vietnamese. They say they do it in one hour, but I do not know if they will still pick up when something breaks on a Saturday. A new company can disappear.
would_change_my_mind: Another Vietnamese owner I know saying it works and that someone actually came to set it up, plus a fair price on the reader.
